answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the yarrow of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zenith of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
